Adding & subtracting有理式加减

21​+31​=65​ — you already know how. Adding x−23​−x+12​ is the exact same move: common denominator, then combine the tops.21​+31​=65​ 你早就会。x−23​−x+12​ 是一模一样的操作：通分，再合并分子。

Difficulty难度 ●●○
⏱ 35 min · ★ essential必会

🔑 Must know必须记住 · Adding & subtracting有理式加减
  1. Factor every denominator; LCD = each different factor at its highest power.把每个分母分解；最简公分母＝每个不同因式取最高次幂。
  2. Rewrite over the LCD, then add or subtract the NUMERATORS only.化成同分母，只对分子加减。
  3. Subtracting: bracket the whole numerator, −(x−2)=−x+2; finish by factoring and cancelling.相减时整个分子加括号，−(x−2)=−x+2；最后分解分子看能否约分。
BA​±DC​=BDAD±BC​

🧗 The hard part难点 · Adding & subtracting有理式加减

Subtracting over a factored LCD在分解后的公分母上做减法

Three things go wrong at once: missing factors, the minus sign, and the final cancel.三件事同时容易出错：漏乘因式、减号分配、最后约分。

  1. x2−95​−x−32​: LCD (x−3)(x+3)x2−95​−x−32​：公分母 (x−3)(x+3)
  2. Top: 5−2(x+3) — bracket it分子：5−2(x+3)——加括号
  3. =5−2x−6=−2x−1 → (x−3)(x+3)−2x−1​, x=±3=5−2x−6=−2x−1 → (x−3)(x+3)−2x−1​，x=±3
Try试一试
Simplify x−4x​−x2−x−12x+24​.化简 x−4x​−x2−x−12x+24​。
Answer答案
(x−4)(x+3)x(x+3)−(x+24)​=(x−4)(x+3)(x+6)(x−4)​=x+3x+6​, x=4, −3(x−4)(x+3)x(x+3)−(x+24)​=(x−4)(x+3)(x+6)(x−4)​=x+3x+6​，x=4, −3

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · Adding & subtracting有理式加减
  • x1​+y1​=x+y2​ ✗ → xyx+y​.x1​+y1​=x+y2​ ✗ → xyx+y​。
  • x−(x−2)=−2 ✗ → +2: the minus hits every term.x−(x−2)=−2 ✗ → +2：减号作用于每一项。
🎯
Opposite denominators (x−3 and 3−x): flip the sign of one fraction instead of multiplying them.分母互为相反数（x−3 与 3−x）：把其中一个分式变号即可，不用相乘。

quiz.q: A cyclist rides 60 km uphill to a lookout at x km/h and returns the same 60 km downhill at (x+10) km/h. (a) Write the total time as one fraction, simplified, and state the restrictions in context. (b) Write the average speed for the whole trip, total time120​, as a single simplified expression. (c) For x=20 find the average speed and explain why it is not the mean of 20 and 30.一名骑行者以 x km/h 的速度上坡骑 60 km 到观景台，再以 (x+10) km/h 的速度下坡骑回同样的 60 km。(a) 把总时间写成一个化简后的分式，并说明情境下的限制。(b) 把全程平均速度 总时间120​ 写成一个化简的式子。(c) 当 x=20 时求平均速度，并解释为什么它不是 20 与 30 的平均数。
quiz.hint: LCD is x(x+10). Average speed is total distance over total time.公分母是 x(x+10)。平均速度 = 总路程 ÷ 总时间。
quiz.ans: (a) T=x(x+10)60(2x+10)​=x(x+10)120(x+5)​ h, x>0; (b) vˉ=x+5x(x+10)​; (c) 24 km/h.(a) T=x(x+10)60(2x+10)​=x(x+10)120(x+5)​ 小时，x>0；(b) vˉ=x+5x(x+10)​；(c) 24 km/h。
quiz.why: T=x60​+x+1060​=x(x+10)60(x+10)+60x​=x(x+10)120(x+5)​. Speeds are positive, so x>0 (and x=0,−10 is automatic).T=x60​+x+1060​=x(x+10)60(x+10)+60x​=x(x+10)120(x+5)​。速度为正，所以 x>0（x=0,−10 自然满足）。
